note: Opportunity cost = daily wage x hearings x days-per-hearing. Wages are the notified rural employment-guarantee wage (VB-G RAM G Act 2025 / ex-MGNREGA), used as a transparent floor for a day lost to a court visit. Urban opportunity cost is higher; user can enter their own daily wage.
source: PIB press release (30 Jun 2026): 'national average notified wage has increased from ₹298.8 per day under MGNREGA to ₹327.4 per day under VB-G RAM G'; '₹300 interim base wage rate, ensuring that no notified wage is below ₹300 per day.' (https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseDetail.aspx?PRID=2279660)
